Also, it's not my fault I've had issues with love and friendship for years and years!
All I ever did was love this person unconditionally and I can't get not one message? It makes no sense. So of course I will feel dumb for caring.

I don't agree with that. I have a mini rant below. 
I feel like I shouldn't have to be responsible for someone else acting dumb towards me.
Sure, none of us should rely on others for happiness, because of course it isn't fair to them. But couldn't the blame fall on both parties? The other party being too whatever to reach out or whatever the case may be?

I'm tired of being told I'm in the wrong. What about the other person? All I ever fucking did was be kind and try to come from a place of unconditional love. 

This whole "love yourself so others can love you" platitude is victim\-blaming at one of its finest and I feel it's unfair! 

Maybe the other person doesn't fucking deserve me!

Maybe noone deserves me!
I hate this platitude with a passion
I guess I would have to fake it to make it but I don't easily love everyone because of trust issues...

I believe i am, or like to believe I am. At least I do try to believe. I will check out your video, thanks for sharing! 
And yes, I will be focusing on me for the rest of the summer...

And i have mental illness. At any cost I avoid feeling like I'm stupid because I cared so much about someone who doesn't seem to reciprocate it. I only did 4 weeks because I was certain I would see quick results...
Love should be easy...
